title: Product Attributes
description: Define product options such as size, color, and material.

help.title: About Product Attributes
help.overview: Attributes are shared option lists, such as Size or Color. A variant later picks one value from each attribute that identifies that SKU. The name is required.

sections.title: How options become a SKU
sections.body: Values are the choices shoppers see, for example S, M, and L. You can store up to 50 values. Position controls the order of the attributes.
items: Visible on the product page shows the list on the storefront. It does not change the price.
Used for variants marks the attribute as one that should split a product into SKUs. The variant itself stores the attribute and the chosen value.
The price the cart charges is the variant price, or the product price when no variant is selected.
